content.text: No MFN mechanic exists anywhere in this agreement. Submitting a compliant finding.

input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation mechanic in either direction. Section 11 (Fees) states Sparkling's entire pricing obligation as payment of the amounts set out in the Fee Schedule, with no obligation to extend Garman terms no less favourable than those given to any third party, and no obligation to disclose or match third-party offers. Searches across the fees, maintenance (Section 10, including the Software Repair Service rate provisions), term/termination and general-matters provisions, and the definitions and schedule list, returned no "most favoured", "no less favourable", best-pricing, comparison, or price-matching language. This satisfies the preferred position (no MFN obligation on Customer), so no redline is warranted; the fallback (defined product, 12-month cap, like-for-like carve-outs) is not engaged because there is no Customer MFN to limit.

mappings.element: Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor.
